statement: (a b c : Nat) : (a + b) + c = (c + b) + a

approaches: Prove reassociation of the left-hand side
Find the swaps needed to put c + b before a

artifact.statement: (a b c : Nat) : (a + b) + c = a + (b + c)

second_finding: Tentative: swap a and c first; this does not account for the parentheses or the order of b and c.
redirected_finding: Use the accepted reassociation first; then Nat.add_comm b c swaps the inner sum, and Nat.add_comm a (c + b) swaps the outer sum.
target_proof:
calc
  (a + b) + c = a + (b + c) := Nat.add_assoc a b c
  _ = a + (c + b) := by rw [Nat.add_comm b c]
  _ = (c + b) + a := by rw [Nat.add_comm a (c + b)]
